factor._note: absent = BERT-base (paper encoder). embedbag = EmbedBagText in encoders.py: same WordPiece tokenizer and input_ids (vocab 30522, max_text_tokens 50, padding_idx 0), nn.Embedding(30522, 64) + attention-mask-weighted mean + MLP 64->256->512 (GELU); ~1.95M embedding + ~0.15M MLP, from scratch, order-blind. hypothesis: An order-blind ~2M embedding bag over the same WordPiece ids keeps f0 test llm_textgen AP within BERT-base's fold spread (>= 90.0; baseline 91.60, folds 91.6-93.7), because the LLM-script vs ASR-transcript cue is lexical and length-level (vocabulary, sentence length, missing disfluencies) rather than syntactic; AUC stays within +-2 of 66.86.
